reason: Both are B2B rigid packaging manufacturers selling containers and closures to producers. Greif focuses on industrial bulk packaging (steel, plastic and fibre drums, IBCs, reconditioning, containerboard). Silgan focuses on consumer goods packaging (food cans, dispensing closures, custom plastic containers). Overlap exists in closures, plastic containers and some food and chemical customers. The core product lines and the main customer base differ, so this is adjacent, not direct.
